messages.subject: NYC ggplot2 meetup
parts:
Hi all,

The next meeting of the NYC R Meetup (http://www.meetup.com/nyhackr/)
will be about ggplot2. If there's anyone reading this list who's not
in the Meetup loop, please join the group and come to the event!
October 1st, 7pm, at NYU. Also, if there's anyone interested in
helping to present, please email me (har...@harris.name). I'm probably
going to present or co-present the introduction and theory, and then
the tentative plan is to have several short presentations of actual
applications.

(Hadley, are your recent Bay Area Meetup slides available anywhere? I
may want to borrow some content...!)

-Harlan
